Class AAImage

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.animatedareadisplay.AAObject
sysmlinjava.views.animatedareadisplay.AAImage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AAImage extends AAObject implements Serializable
Representation of an image object in an area display. Contains the parameters needed to display the object as an image in the display from a specified image file and at a specified position, size, rotation, and z-order in the area display.

ModelerOne

    • imageFileURL

      public String imageFileURL
      URL of the file that contains the image to be displayed in the area display. If the URL is for a file on the local file system, be sure to use an absolute path to the file. The file will be loaded from the "working" directory of the TaskMaster, so use of a relative path to the image file is likely to fail to locate it properly.

  • Constructor Details

    • AAImage

      public AAImage(String uid, AnimatedAreaActionEnum action, String imageFileURL, Integer resizeWidth, Integer resizeHeight, Integer rotateDegrees, XY xyPosition, Integer zOrder)
      Constructor for all attributes
      Parameters:
      uid - unique identifier (always required)
      action - the action to be performed in the display of the text (always required)
      imageFileURL - URL for the file that contains the image to be displayed. (required if action is create, optionally null if update)
      resizeWidth - width (pixels) to resize the image to for the display. Null or zero for no resize
      resizeHeight - height (pixels) to resize the image to for the display. Null or zero for no resize
      rotateDegrees - degrees (clockwise) to rotate the image for the display. Null or zero for no resize
      xyPosition - X,Y position in the display of the center of the image (required if action is create, optionally null for update)
      zOrder - order of the image in the layers of objects in the area display. Lower number is closer to viewer. (optionally null for all actions)

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(AnimatedAreaActionEnum action, String imageFileURL, Integer resizeWidth, Integer resizeHeight, Integer rotateDegrees, XY xyPosition, Integer zOrder)
      Updates/changes the image display as specified by parameter values, with value null indicating no change
      Parameters:
      action - the action to be performed in the display of the text (required, cannot be null)
      imageFileURL - different URL for the file that contains the different image to be displayed, or null if no change.
      resizeWidth - different width (pixels) to resize the image to for the display, or null if no change
      resizeHeight - different height (pixels) to resize the image to for the display, or null if no change Null or zero for no resize
      rotateDegrees - different degrees (clockwise) to rotate the image for the display, or null if no change
      xyPosition - different X,Y position in the display of the center of the image, or null if no change
      zOrder - different order of the image in the layers of objects in the area display (lower number is closer to viewer.), or null if no change.
